Remediation applied 2026-09-06 (operator-approved):

1. AC1 DONE — `core.fsmonitor` and `core.untrackedCache` unset in ~/rebar/.git/config (readback clean). All live fsmonitor daemons stopped by explicit PID (11052, 11936, 12261); count now 0. Note: Copilot CLI sessions were already immune via GIT_CONFIG_KEY override; claude/codex/Terminal/VS Code sessions now stop spawning daemons too.
2. AC2 DONE — `git worktree prune` removed 4 dead registrations; audited all 116 existing worktrees (dirty status + origin/main..HEAD). 19 worktrees <24h old kept (several carry in-flight Gerrit changes; `~/rebar-membound` has uncommitted changes — operator should review). 26 older clean+fully-merged ephemeral worktrees (janitor-*/fix-*/close-*/debug-*/verify-*) retired via non-force `git worktree remove`. 71 older dirty-or-unmerged worktrees deliberately LEFT IN PLACE pending salvage review (list preserved in audit; regenerate with the same audit loop). Worktree count 120 → 91.
3. AC3 DONE — launchd agent `com.joeoakhart.mem-sentinel` installed and running: 5-min snapshots of free mem, swap, memory-pressure %, fseventsd/mds RSS, fsmonitor-daemon count, python/git process counts, PPID-1 count, top-5 RSS → ~/Library/Logs/mem-sentinel.log (5MB rotation).
4. AC4 — local uv→python MCP/gate leak ticketed separately: 7495-36ea-df75-4a3d (centauric-gnomic-hake), linked context there; distinct from remote 9ea3-7d07-ea55-4496.
